answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The grove lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the plume is where a second reviewer recomputes them. By the vertex of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, no identity may audit its own recruit.
